dependencies.basis: DGBAS compiles Taiwan national accounts (GDP by production and expenditure) according to the 2008 System of National Accounts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The data are based on the 2008 SNA.

dependencies.basis: DGBAS National Accounts Yearbook methodology states adoption of the 2008 SNA (with limited exceptions such as weapon-systems capitalization).
dependencies.evidence_quote: At present, we adopt the 2008 SNA version, although some treatments, such as the capitalization of expenditures on weapon systems, haven’t been followed.

dependencies.basis: Taiwan Input-Output tables are compiled on the basis of the System of National Accounts 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 2016 Input-Output statistics are based on the System of National Accounts 2008, as well as the strict change of ownership principle according to the 6th edition of Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).

dependencies.basis: Input-Output statistics apply the strict change-of-ownership principle of BPM6 for goods for processing and related trade flows.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 2016 Input-Output statistics are based on the System of National Accounts 2008, as well as the strict change of ownership principle according to the 6th edition of Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).

dependencies.basis: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) compiles Balance of Payments statistics in accordance with BPM6 (implemented from 2016, with historical series converted).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Beginning 2016, Taiwan’s BOP is compiled in accordance with "the Sixth Edition of Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6)."

dependencies.basis: CBC SDDS/metadata confirm BOP concepts, definitions, classification and presentation follow BPM6 guidelines.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Beginning 2016, Taiwan's BOP statistics are compiled in broad conformity with the guidelines of the BPM6. ... In principle, Taiwan’s BOP data are classified and published according to the BPM6.

dependencies.basis: Taiwan CPI uses a local adaptation of the Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP); DGBAS has adjusted household-consumption classifications in line with COICOP 2018.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 聯合國於2018 年發布新版的民間消費分類架構，即COICOP 2018 ... 配合COICOP 2018 調整家庭消費歸類

dependencies.basis: CPI item weights and basket structure are derived from Household Final Consumption Expenditure of National Income, which is based on the Family Income and Expenditure Survey.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The major structure of weights is based on the Household Final Consumption Expenditure of National Income and is updated annually. ... The weights are based on the 2016 Household Final Consumption Expenditure of National Income, which derives from the Family Income/Expenditure Survey.

dependencies.basis: Private final consumption expenditure and other components in the national accounts are deflated using detailed consumer price indices compiled by DGBAS.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Items of Deflators ... Private final consumption expenditure ... Consumer price indices of food, non-alcoholic beverages ... Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics

dependencies.basis: Customs-based merchandise trade statistics classify commodities according to the Harmonized System (HS) via the Customs Import Tariff and Import and Export Commodity Classification of the Republic of China.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Goods are classified according to the Customs Import Tariff and Import and Export Commodity Classification of the Republic of China.

dependencies.basis: Trade statistics methodology explicitly bases commodity classification on the HS framework and the ROC Customs Tariff.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 進出口貿易統計之貨品分類，除有下列各款情形之一者外，依照中華民國海關進口稅則輸出入貨品分類表合訂本規定辦理
